💪 Train. Fight. Grow. Become UNSTOPPABLE!

Start your journey as a beginner and work your way up to becoming one of the strongest ROBLOXians! 🏆

🏋️ Train to increase your Strength
🌎 Discover and unlock powerful Gyms
⚔️ Battle other Players
🐾 Collect and upgrade awesome Pets
🔥 Unlock new Moves and abilities
🏟️ Compete in Arenas
💎 Earn rewards, improve your character and keep getting stronger!

✨ PLUS BENEFITS:
• x2 Strength from Training
• +2 Daily Fortune Spins
• x2 Chest Rewards
• +1 Pet Slot

🎁 GROUP REWARDS:
Join the Kings XF group to unlock the Group Chest +1 Daily Spin!
